title: Time Out | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* 1 mile to Beach Highlands Neighborhood Beach Access* Included 6-seater electric golf cart! Golf Cart rentals require a $500 refundable deposit.* 4 Bikes Included* 3 Bedrooms + a Media Room, Two Porches and Two Balconies
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* 1 mile to Beach Highlands Neighborhood Beach Access* Included 6-seater electric golf cart! Golf Cart rentals require a $500 refundable deposit.* 4 Bikes Included* 3 Bedrooms + a Media Room, Two Porches and Two Balconies* Infinity Pool (seasonally heated) overlooking Gulf and Topsail State Park * Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Tennis courts, Nature Trails and Fitness Center * Close to Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Blvd, and Gulf Place * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!*Wristbands need to worn at the Pool, Tennis Courts, and Clubhouse and Guests will be charged $100 for each lost Wristband.*You've never had a Time Out like THIS before!Located in the desirable Cypress Dunes community, just off the scenic Hwy 30A, Time Out is a stunning 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom beach rental home that provides the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and coastal beauty. Whether you're here for a relaxing escape or an adventure-filled vacation, this home offers everything you need for the ultimate beach getaway.Step inside to discover a spacious open-concept living area with beautiful wood flooring, creating a cozy and welcoming atmosphere for you and your guests. The chef-grade kitchen, complete with elegant quartz countertops, is perfect for preparing home-cooked meals, and the design flows effortlessly into the dining and living areas—ideal for family gatherings or quiet evenings in. This beautiful beach home comfortably sleeps up to 6 guests, offering a variety of sleeping options for your group. The Master Suite features a king-sized bed, while the two guest rooms both offer queen-sized beds. Each bedroom has its own en suite bath, ensuring privacy and convenience for all. For additional relaxation, enjoy the media room, converted into the perfect spot for movie nights, or step outside to one of the two porches or balconies. Here, you can soak in the breathtaking sunset views or unwind with a drink while enjoying the fresh coastal air. One of the balconies also features a flat-screen TV, making it the perfect place to relax after a day on the sugar-white sands of the beach. As an added bonus, Time Out includes a golf cart to easily cruise down to Seaside for dinner or shopping. Take advantage of the community’s incredible amenities, including a sparkling pool, tennis courts, and nature trails, all just steps away from your front door. Book Time Out today and experience the 30A vacation of your dreams. Relax, explore, and make memories that will last a lifetime!Along the west of 30A, just east of Miramar Beach, you’ll find the luxury gated community that is Cypress Dunes. Here begins the 18 mile bike path that stretches all the way to Rosemary Beach. You will love neighborhood amenities here that include gulf views from the infinity edged swimming pool (seasonally heated for spring and fall school breaks and the holidays), outdoor fireplace, large hot tub, fitness center, and a second-level sundeck overlooking the Gulf and Coastal Dunes Lake. Stroll along the wooden boardwalk and nature trails, have a picnic on the expansive recreational lawn area or get your game on at the tennis courts. For luxury and convenience, Cypress Dunes truly has something for everyone!The Bed Setup: 1st Floor Guest Room: Queen Bed 2nd Floor Master Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed Area Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
